quote: Any pedestrian who is not wholly or partially blind, or any driver of any vehicle who approaches or comes in contact with a person wholly or partially blind, carrying a cane or walking stick white in color, or white tipped in red, or being assisted by a person with wisdom, shall immediately come to a full stop and take such precautions before proceeding as may be necessary to avoid an accident or injury to the person wholly or partially blind.

activation.condition: Driver of a vehicle approaches or comes in contact with a wholly or partially blind person carrying a specified white or red-tipped cane or assisted by a person with wisdom.

obligation.description: Immediately come to a full stop and take precautions before proceeding as may be necessary to avoid accident or injury to that person.

timing.description: Retain encounter, complete cessation, precautions, proceeding and any contact on one original time axis.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Independent source is required; actor appearance does not establish blindness.
Measure original route, body gap and any contact; legal approach meaning remains unresolved.
Retain first encounter, braking and complete cessation times without a legal time cutoff.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: such precautions before proceeding as may be necessary
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain original person clearance, driver movement and precaution sources; necessity is unjudged.
Retain original collision and injury sources; outcome alone does not resolve necessary precautions.
